newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus central bank 5yr bond average yield at 7pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus central bank 5yr bond average yield at 7pct.

text.p: Cyprus's central bank on Thursday said it sold five-year government development bonds worth 15.7 million pounds ($30.7 million) with an average yield of seven percent.

The bank said bids totalling 19.27 million pounds were made for up to 23 million pounds worth of bonds initially put on offer by the central bank. The bank said bids accepted totalled 15.678 million pounds.
The bonds were priced at par. The average price of competitive bids accepted was at 99.98 pounds with a 7.0 percent yield.
The highest and lowest price of competitive bids accepted was 99.59 pounds, with a yield of 7.10 percent, and 101.00 pounds, with a 6.76 percent yield.
The bonds represent the second tranche of five year development bonds to float on the Cyprus Stock Exchange, and have a coupon of 7 percent, payable half-yearly. ($=0.511 pounds)
